speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain that radiates down your leg. To help you, I need to ask you a few questions: Does this pain travel past your knee? Do you have any weakness or numbness in that leg or foot? And have you lost control of your bladder or bowel?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Herniated Disc (likely L4-L5 or L5-S1).

I have your history and the description of radiation to the foot is consistent with nerve root compression. Given the acute onset during exercise and the specific radiation pattern, this is highly suggestive of a herniated disc. Would you like me to order an MRI to confirm the level and severity of the disc herniation?
